Pre-release for testing. The Calibre interface (writing changes back to Calibre) follows in a later beta.

## New

- **Metadata area.** Edit title, authors, author sort, series and number, publisher, language, ISBN and tags of your books. Several authors are separated with `&` as in Calibre. Apply with *Ctrl+Enter*, save with *Ctrl+S* (with backup, as everywhere). File names are never changed, so KOReader keeps reading positions and highlights.
- **Comparison with Calibre and KOReader.** If `metadata.calibre` is found, Calibre's values are shown next to the form; differing ones can be taken over with **←**. Values you edited in KOReader itself (`custom_metadata.lua`) are shown too, because KOReader displays them instead of the file.
- **From Calibre** puts all differing values of a book into the form; **Fill gaps from Calibre** fills empty fields of all books.
- **Subtitle from a Calibre column** (optional, *Settings > Books > Metadata*): e.g. `#subtitle`, read and written the way Calibre stores it in the book.
- Filters: changed, differs from Calibre, no author sort, no language, no ISBN, edited in KOReader.
- Library: new columns Publisher, Language and ISBN (hidden at first; right-click a column header).
- Smaller Windows setup (only the English word lists of wordfreq).

## Note

Calibre writes its own metadata into a book when it sends it to the e-reader again. Until the Calibre interface arrives, change the values in Calibre as well.

## Install

- **Linux:** `install.sh` from this repository, or *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on).
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3-beta1.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
